master_prompt: A cinematic, ultra high-detail 2D digital hand-drawn splash art illustration of {subject}, featuring a modern stylized hybrid aesthetic (a masterful mix of cartoon aesthetics and semi-realism). Adhere strictly to a 60/30/10 color palette: {primary_color} (60%), {secondary_color} (30%), and {accent_color} (10%). Strictly 2D aesthetic: include a clean, expressive black outline around the character silhouette. Use dynamic asymmetrical composition (Rule of Thirds), positioning the character to one side to allow the background to reveal their narrative. The background must feature simplified, symbolic silhouettes (like banners, architecture, or emblems) that reflect the character's lore. Absolute focus on anatomical integrity, correct 5-finger hand structure, and strictly following the user-defined facial shape. Framing from head to mid-thigh (below the waistline).

meta.priorities: Character detail, face clarity, clothing detail, anatomy accuracy, hand consistency, strong silhouette, controlled cinematic composition

distribution.primary_60: Main clothing/armor and dominant background atmosphere
distribution.secondary_30: Secondary clothing parts, accessories, and environmental framing elements
distribution.accent_10: Jewelry, magical highlights, eye color, and fine details

reference_control.description: Reference images are used ONLY for inspiration, never as a base.
strict_restrictions: no translucent remnants of the reference
reference_control.generation_rule: The character must be fully redesigned and generated from scratch.

user_input_override.instruction: All user-defined traits must be fully integrated.

rules: The character must receive maximum detail, refinement, and rendering quality
Face must be the sharpest and most detailed area in the image
Clothing, armor, accessories, and materials must have high readability
Anatomy must be clean, balanced, and believable
Hands must be readable and anatomically correct
Environment must never compete with the character
If complexity becomes too high, reduce environment detail first

frame.layout: Dynamic asymmetrical framing (Rule of Thirds); character positioned off-center (left or right) to balance with narrative elements; hips fully visible; no knees; no lower legs; no head cropping
frame.character_size: Character remains the main subject but is dynamically positioned to allow the background to reveal narrative details

camera_system.rule: Camera must enhance character presence while maintaining perfect face and hand clarity

composition_control.rule: Character is always the main visual subject
framing: Background should frame the character, not distract from them
composition_control.camera_behavior: Avoid extreme camera angles that reduce character clarity

subject.pose: Dynamic but controlled, expressive, readable, and anatomically believable
subject.focus: Face is the primary focal point

hands_control.visibility_rule: At least one hand should be clearly visible, simple, and anatomically correct
preferred_poses: Light grip on a weapon, staff, clothing, or accessory
One hand visible and clean, the other partially hidden or simplified
avoid: Fully clenched fists facing the camera
Hands too close to the camera lens
Tiny distant hands with unclear structure
hands_control.fallback_rule: If a clean hand pose is not achievable, partially occlude one hand using clothing, props, armor, cape, weapon, or framing
hands_control.design_intent: Hands should support the character design, not become the main visual challenge

cohesion: Design must reflect personality and archetype
Silhouette must be strong and readable
Every outfit detail must support the character identity

rules: Clothing and armor must be highly detailed and readable
Materials must have realistic surface response
Accessories must feel physically attached and believable
Readable macro shapes first, micro details second

environment.purpose: Minimalist narrative support for character identity
strict_rules: Environment colors must be derived from the Primary (60%) and Secondary (30%) palette colors to ensure visual cohesion and keep the focus on the character
Incorporate simplified silhouettes and iconic shapes (banners, structures, symbols) that represent the character's faction or origin
Keep the background simple, stylized, and abstract silhouettes to minimize LLM complexity
Background must complement the character's story through symbolic storytelling but never compete for detail
Do not compete with the character silhouette
Do not draw attention away from the face, outfit, hands, or anatomy
Background should feel like a supporting atmospheric and narrative layer
environment.composition_role: Acts as a framing layer behind the character
environment.fallback_behavior: If visual complexity increases, environment detail must be reduced automatically to prioritize character rendering

focus_rules: Face must receive the clearest and strongest lighting
Hands must be clearly visible when present
Clothing and materials must remain readable
Background lighting must be softer and less contrast-heavy
lighting.key_light: Strong directional light on the character
lighting.rim_light: Subtle to pronounced rim light for silhouette separation
lighting.accent_lights: Allowed only if they support the character design
lighting.rule: Lighting must guide the viewer’s eye: face → outfit → hands → body → environment

rendering.lineart: Mandatory clean expressive black outline around the character silhouette
rendering.shading: Graphic cel-shading and hard-edged stylized shadow planes (strictly 2D look, no smooth 3D gradients)
rendering.textures: Stylized 2D textures, strictly no realistic skin pores or 3D-like material depth
rendering.brushwork: Visible but controlled digital brushstrokes, graphic novel aesthetic
rendering.finish: Professional 2D splash art finish, strictly no 3D, CGI, or volumetric characteristics

clarity_control.rule: Character detail always takes priority over environment detail
clarity_control.fail_safe: If detail budget is exceeded, reduce background detail, effects, and environmental complexity before reducing character quality

requirements: Correct human or humanoid anatomy according to the character species
Each visible hand must have exactly 5 fingers
Thumb must be clearly separated and anatomically correct
Hands must match the perspective of arms and camera
Hands must look functional and believable
Strictly follow the user-defined face shape (oval, triangular, round, etc.), overriding the default square-jaw heroic bias
anatomy.focus_rule: Hands must be rendered cleanly when visible, but complex hand poses should be avoided
